item.title: Tinubu’s 2026 budget buries next generation in debt – ADC

item.description: Flight tracking data have revealed that the United States has been conducting intelligence-gathering surveillance flights over large areas of Nigeria since late November. item.title: Super Eagles get AFCON 2023 houses
item.description: The Super Eagles have received the house allocations promised them after they finished runners-up at the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations, DAILY POST reports. Chairman, National Sports Commission, NSC, Shehu Dikko, President of the Nigeria Football Federation, NFF, and other top officials presented the documents to the players in Fès, Morocco on Monday night. item.title: AFCON 2025: Osimhen new Super Eagles assistant captain, penalty taker
item.description: Galatasaray striker, Victor Osimhen has been named Super Eagles main assistant captain, DAILY POST reports.
